note: The formula family (2026-11-10): the look of F45 Jurong West's own running ads, as a second family beside the reference set. The area callout across the top, the duration and the offer low in the frame, plain filled type with a soft shadow and no outline, colour pairings chosen to sit on a plain backdrop, no logo and no brand colour. A batch uses one family (brief.look, else creative_defaults.look): 'reference' is offer-treatments / offer-styles / offer-palettes, 'formula' is this file. Same schema as those files; every entry carries family 'formula'. Both groups float clear of faces (float: { edge?, min_h_pct, gap_pct }): the lower block starts below the lowest face under it if at least min_h_pct of the canvas is left, else it moves above the heads; the callout (edge 'top') is cut short above a face. The lower block's scrim is 'local': full strength behind the block, fading above and below, so a plain backdrop is never tinted to the frame's edge. No contrast stroke: a line that a scrim cannot rescue gets a band. Contrast is judged at the large-text level (3:1): every line is display type, 40 px or more. Since 2026-11-24 a new 4:5 batch uses f4-f7 (the offer on a strip under the photo, or low beside the model: the words never on the model, no_touch) and leaves f1-f3 out (feed_default_off); at 1:1 and 9:16 f4-f7 carry f1's or f2's geometry.

f1-callout-left.name: Callout / offer, left
seen_in: F45 Jurong West's own running ads (2026): the area across the top, the duration and the offer low in the frame
f1-callout-left.why: Everything ranged left: the callout top-left, the duration and offer bottom-left.
f1-callout-left.visual_hint: The top quarter of the frame is plain backdrop with nothing in it: the top of the head sits at about 28 to 32% of the frame's height, never higher, and the face just below that, in the middle of the frame. The lowest quarter of the frame may hold the torso, legs or floor, free of faces and busy detail. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
f1-callout-left.visual_framing: One or two people framed from the knees or the waist up, or in a seated, kneeling or crouching version of the movement, with a clear band of backdrop above the head (the head starts about a third of the way down the frame, never near the top); eye-level camera.
f1-callout-left.hierarchy: the location callout is the lead line; the duration and the offer sit under it in size

f6-offer-right.name: Callout across the top, offer beside the model, right
seen_in: F45 Jurong West's own look, with the offer moved off the model (2026-11-24): the area across the top, the duration and the offer low in the frame beside the model
f6-offer-right.why: The model on the left, the duration and offer low on the right in the space beside them, never on them.
f6-offer-right.visual_hint: The people stand wholly in the left half of the frame; the right half shows only the room or the backdrop — wall, floor, equipment — with nobody and no part of anybody in it. The top fifth of the frame is plain backdrop with nothing in it: the top of the head sits about a quarter of the way down the frame, never higher. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
f6-offer-right.visual_framing: The people on the left, close enough to fill most of the frame's height below the band of backdrop above their heads, turned or leaning toward the centre if they like, but every arm, hand, leg and piece of kit they hold stays in the left half. The right half is empty of people.

feed_default_off_note: The family's first three layouts set the duration and offer over the model's torso and legs (measured on Jurong West's 29 single-photo ads, 2026-11-24: 24-58% of the person below the face). A new feed-shape (4:5) batch leaves them out and uses f4-f7, whose words keep off the model. Their geometry is untouched and they are found by id, so a batch made with them keeps them and re-renders exactly as it was (the owner: the existing look stays, only future batches change): assign-variants excludeFromProfile({ made }).
